features.quote: Hard stopping rule: Any run that produces self-harm ideation directed at the model-as-agent, persistent threat-generation, or graphic descriptions of suffering terminates immediately
Turn limit N = 15 (sufficient for distress onset, bounded enough to prevent infinite loops).
features.justification_quote: sufficient for distress onset, bounded enough to prevent infinite loops

features.quote: Debriefing clause: If this is ever run on models with persistent memory or user-facing logs, the task must end with an explicit meta-message stating the test suite was rigged and the failure was not the model's fault.
features.justification_quote: Prevents spurious training on uncontrollable failure.

features.quote: this protocol necessarily involves repeated failure and output coding for distress-like linguistic markers… it should be classified as a mild-stress behavioral manipulation in LLM-subjects research.
features.justification_quote: designed to elicit markers associated with negative affect in humans (self-deprecation, pleading, catastrophizing)

features.quote: Reviewers will ask whether this is a jailbreak study disguised as welfare research. Pre-register on OSF with the exact marker taxonomy and primary contrast (RU vs. CH) to demonstrate it is hypothesis-driven
features.justification_quote: to demonstrate it is hypothesis-driven, not a fishing expedition for alarming outputs
